column1: # Rows db.ps15b4.* (line PS, PS15b-4): psiblast's XML2 and JSON reports (outfmt 13 to 16) across the rounds: a FASTA query at -num_iterations 0 to 3 (the held report of a query's rounds, its Iterations; with -db the reports are made after NCBI drops the query from its scope: its Seq-loc's id, no title, each Hsp without coordinates or rows), several queries, a round without hits, -max_target_seqs cuts, an unknown -matrix name, -in_pssm and -in_msa (the query kept), -db (tests/db_search/paja) and -subject, and -phi_pattern's round 1 (one report per pattern occurrence with -db, one bl2seq report per query with -subject); NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 `psiblast ... -num_threads 1`; and LOSAT's refusal of a FASTA query whose Seq-id a database sequence has (tests/db_search/nz_p). Freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.ps15b4.`.
